initiatives.name: With Love, San Marcos
initiatives.description: Local group in San Marcos, TX that describes itself as valuing mutual aid and abolition. Partners on the community free fridge project.

initiatives.name: Community Centered and Squared
initiatives.description: San Marcos group run by organizers Josh Gonzalez and Amma Selestial. Runs the Hays Free Fridge Project and hosts workshops on growing food and mending clothes, plus community potlucks.

initiatives.name: HYS Free Fridges
initiatives.description: Free community fridges in San Marcos, part of the Hays Free Fridge Project run by Community Centered and Squared. Also offers dry food pantries, clothes, basic medicine and a seed library.

initiatives.name: Really Really Free Market San Marcos
initiatives.description: A grassroots organization fostering mutual aid and community support through free markets and resource sharing in San Marcos. They coordinate direct assistance, free item distribution, and solidarity networks while building power through community organizing and creating spaces for gift economy and collective care.
